info.name: NFHS Unity + Pixellot Club — Pulse API exploration
info.description:
Exploration collection for the planned Pulse cloud lookup feature:

  "I am this VPU > I have this event > I was not able to stream because of X issue"

Run order for the scenario chain:
  1. Unity: Game/Event lookup  — seeds broadcast_key, game_key, pixellot_id
  2. Unity: Broadcast detail   — seeds vod_key; shows status (on_air/complete/scheduled)
  3. Unity: Live stream URL    (only if status = on_air)
  4. Unity: VOD stream URL     (only if status = complete)
  5. Club:  Venue profile      — hardware + metrics.values health indicators for the pixellot_id

Each request's test script auto-captures the IDs the next request needs into the active environment, so after step 1 the rest just run.

Auth: every request sends `Authorization: {{nfhs_auth}}` or `{{club_auth}}`. Set those env vars to the full header value (e.g. `Bearer eyJ...`). If either API actually wants a different header (e.g. `x-api-key`), edit the header on the request — the variable plumbing stays the same.
